trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the game's final reward, awarded automatically once the other 54 trophies are in your account. Work through the story first, then use the free-roam checklist to sweep up collectibles, activities and side missions. There is no separate task to complete here, and it cannot be missed once the last trophy unlocks.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. Follow the mission markers and see the sequence through; it is a normal story beat, so you cannot skip it during a normal playthrough. The game also keeps a mission replay option if you want to watch it again.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).
steps: Play the opening Gone Fishing mission

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 to add this to your list. Chapter 1 advances automatically as you clear its missions, so there is no special condition to chase. Because chapter progress is saved, this cannot be missed on a standard run.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks with the chapter credits. Keep following the main objective marker and the story will carry you through. There is no missable condition tied to it, so a normal playthrough is enough.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: This is awarded for completing Chapter 3. No side objective or collectible is required; simply advance the main story until the chapter closes. You can replay the chapter later if you want to see the scenes again.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 to earn it. As with the earlier chapters, finishing the last mission is enough to trigger the unlock. It is tied to story progress and cannot be permanently missed.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is handed out for finishing the final mission. Save it for the end of your first story run so the ending lands properly, then watch the credits roll. It is a guaranteed story reward rather than a missable objective.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).
steps: Reach and complete the final mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission to unlock this one. Treat it like any other main mission: follow the prompt, deliver, and finish the objective. It sits inside the story flow, so there is no limited window to worry about.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist and the trophy follows. Focus on the heist setup and execution objectives rather than optional approaches. It is a scripted story event, so taking your time will not cost you the trophy.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play to earn this trophy. Stick with the mission objectives and see the sequence through to its end. Since it is a main mission, it stays available through the replay menu afterwards.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: This pops when you complete Headliners. It is a normal mission completion trophy with no hidden stipulation. Clear the mission and move on; nothing can lock you out of it.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown for this trophy. Follow the mission marker and finish the takedown sequence. Being a story mission, it is neither time-limited nor missable.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory to unlock it. Follow the objective chain until the mission ends. There are no extra conditions beyond completing the mission itself.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold trophy asks for full completion of the game. Use the in-game percentage as your master checklist, since missions, collectibles, activities and side content all count toward it. Because it is a cumulative goal, you can work on it at your own pace after the story and it cannot be missed.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts to earn this silver trophy. Stunts register when you land a jump, flip or other aerial trick cleanly, so chain them during free roam. You can grind the number anywhere there is a ramp, and progress carries across the whole save.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Check the activities menu to see the different categories on offer, then take part in at least one of each. The trophy is about sampling rather than winning, so a single attempt per type is enough.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Work through the range challenge list one at a time and replay any you have not yet medalled. Because each challenge can be retried, nothing here is missable; it is simply a test of accuracy.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Travel to each drone race marker, enter the event and take first place before moving to the next. The locations stay open in free roam, so you can revisit any race you lose.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).
steps: Locate each Top Fun drone race
Win the race at that spot

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each distinct race you take first place in counts, so look for a variety of race markers around Leonida instead of replaying the same one. Progress is cumulative with no deadline, so you can chip away at it whenever you are in the mood.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Accept his fishing challenge at the spot and out-score him within the rules of the event. If you lose, you can ask for a rematch, so this is not missable.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).
steps: Meet Cal at the fishing spot

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game to pop this. Find one of the arcade cabinets around Leonida, step up to the machine and play a game through to its ending. Any cabinet and any game counts, so just finish one.
trophies.source: Sources: GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. His favours form an optional chain, and the last mission only appears once you have cleared his earlier requests. Because this is side content with a limited availability window, do it as soon as it opens instead of leaving it for the endgame.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).
trophies.missable_reason: Andy's final mission is an optional side chain that can be locked out once its window passes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through his side requests and then finish the last one to claim it. This character chain may become unavailable after certain story progress, so tackle it during free roam before moving on.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).
trophies.missable_reason: Kenton's optional mission chain has a limited window and can be lost if left too late.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow his side mission thread to its conclusion. Because it is optional character content rather than a main story beat, it is easy to overlook and may close off after you advance too far.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).
trophies.missable_reason: Billy's chain is optional and time-sensitive, so it can be lost by advancing the story too far.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. These are the random character encounters scattered through the state, each with its own short arc. Many stranger missions only appear during a limited window, so track them as you explore instead of assuming they will wait.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger strands are time-limited and can disappear if you ignore them while they are available.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Clear his earlier side jobs first, then finish the last one. It is a limited-availability chain, so park other cleanup until you have this one banked.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).
trophies.missable_reason: Randy's optional chain can be missed once its availability window closes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work through his side requests and then the last one. As with the other character chains, it is optional and best handled while its marker is still active.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).
trophies.missable_reason: Tyrone's optional chain may become unavailable later in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. The meditation spots show up on the map once you are near them; visit each and hold the meditation action until it completes. They are permanent world locations, so you can tick them off in any order with no risk of missing one.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).
steps: Locate meditation spots on the map

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Speak to him to learn which rare animal he wants, track it in the wild and bring it back. Because it is a unique spawn tied to his request, handle it as soon as the hunt opens rather than leaving it for post-game cleanup.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).
trophies.missable_reason: The unique animal is a one-off spawn tied to Bret's request window.
steps: Talk to Bret about the hunt

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Pick up cards wherever you find them and fill out three full sets. Only three sets are needed, so focus on finishing sets rather than hoarding random duplicates.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Look for the WAiNK spots around Leonida and perform the action at each one. The count is cumulative, so repeated visits to the same spot do not pad the total; explore widely instead.
trophies.source: Sources: GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the timed or skill-based tasks listed in the pause menu, so pick whatever suits your playstyle. There is no required order and no expiry, meaning you can clear them at your own pace.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build up four stars while together, then break line of sight and hide until the police give up. Because you can trigger a wanted level whenever you like, this can be retried until it works.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).
steps: Get to 4 stars with your partner
Hide until the wanted level clears

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Line up three nearby stores, hit them in sequence and keep moving so the police never fully lose the trail. If you lose the stars mid-chain, simply reset and try again.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).
steps: Keep the wanted level active throughout

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every time you first see or use a new vehicle, it is logged in your discovery list. Drive a wide variety of cars, bikes and trucks rather than sticking to one favourite to build the count.
trophies.source: Sources: GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Save the meter until at least five hostile enemies are in view, activate it and eliminate them before it runs out. Pick a busy encounter so there are enough targets in one window.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).
steps: Find a group of 5 or more enemies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This is a one-off stunt tied to the airport: get a vehicle onto the runway and take off in a way the game flags as unscheduled. Because it depends on a specific airport setup, do it deliberately rather than waiting for a random opportunity later.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).
trophies.missable_reason: It is a single airport-specific stunt that is easy to pass by and cannot be summoned later.
steps: Get a vehicle onto the runway

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points to a Rhino tank encounter. When a Rhino shows up, take it on rather than avoiding it, since these armoured encounters are tied to specific moments and are not something you can summon on demand later.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).
trophies.missable_reason: The Rhino encounter is a specific, one-off scenario tied to a particular moment.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Scope the store, deal with or avoid the cameras and staff, and grab the goods without raising an alarm. If you are spotted, restart the robbery and try a cleaner approach.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five different vaults, crack them open and make it away before the police stop you. Each successful escape counts, so failed attempts simply need redoing.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, take its cargo and get away clean. Carrying cash drawers may slow you down, so bring a fast getaway vehicle and a planned route out of the area.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).
steps: Stop it and take the cash

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The state's districts unlock on the map as you visit them; travel to each one to fill out the exploration list. Since exploring is permanent, you can do this in any order alongside other cleanup.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find the gang-run operations scattered around Leonida and hit at least one from every gang. Check which gangs you have already covered so you do not waste time repeating the same crew.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach and take part in the cocktail moment there when it becomes available. It belongs to the early part of the story, so do not be surprised if the opportunity disappears once you move past that stretch of the game.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).
trophies.missable_reason: It is an early-story moment that will not reappear once you move past that window.
steps: Enjoy the view to unlock it

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The trophy rewards a specific, exaggerated escape: get yourself inside a showroom and drive out through the glass rather than the door. It is a one-off stunt opportunity, so do it on purpose when the setup is right.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).
trophies.missable_reason: It depends on a specific showroom stunt that is easy to overlook and hard to recreate later.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Visit that alley and complete a game with a proper follow-through on your throw. The venue stays open, so you can retry as many games as you need.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates alley

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a character moment built around your partnership, unlocked by taking part in the right public interaction together. Because it reads as a specific story beat rather than a repeatable activity, treat it as time-limited and pursue it while that part of the story is active.
trophies.source: Sources: GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).
trophies.missable_reason: It is a one-off partnership moment that will not repeat once that story window closes.
steps: Watch for partnership moments during the story
Take part in the public event

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. This trophy tracks the decisions you make through the game rather than a single event, so there is nothing special to hunt for. Keep playing the story and side content and the counter will fill on its own over a full playthrough.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).
steps: Keep making story and side choices

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This one is triggered by failing at something and then succeeding on your next attempt, so a deliberate fail followed by a clean retry is the way to coax it out. Since it relies on a specific pair of events, it is easy to overlook and may only be available in certain situations.
trophies.source: Sources: PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).
trophies.missable_reason: It needs a specific fail-then-succeed moment that may not be available at all times.
steps: Fail an attempt at a task

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened. This trophy comes from witnessing one of the game's strange, unexplained events in the world. Keep your eyes open while exploring and investigate odd happenings rather than driving past them, because these moments are one-off encounters.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com).
trophies.missable_reason: It is a one-off world event that you can drive straight past without ever triggering.
steps: Witness the event to unlock it

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. Hit an enemy with a melee attack from a moving vehicle to knock them down. Set up a target near a slow-moving car and time the strike; if you miss, there are plenty of other chances.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).
steps: Get in a vehicle near an enemy
Land a melee hit from the car

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn a quarter of a million dollars laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Feed marked cash through your contact laundering options and keep going until the laundered total reaches the target. It is a money grind rather than a missable event, so work on it whenever you have marked bills to spare.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a large amount across all shops. Buy clothes, vehicles, weapons or upgrades from any shops in Leonida and let the purchases add up. Since spending is cumulative, this comes naturally over a full playthrough and has no deadline.
trophies.source: Sources: GTA Wiki (https://gta.fandom.com) and PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Save up and buy every garage listed on the property market. Each purchase is permanent, so you can work through the list at your own pace once the money is there.
trophies.source: Sources: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide (https://psnprofiles.com) and Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles eligible for the app, register them through its menu and repeat until ten are logged. The app keeps your registrations, so you can do this in batches without worrying about losing progress.
trophies.source: Sources: Exophase GTA VI trophy list (https://www.exophase.com) and PowerPyx GTA VI walkthrough (https://www.powerpyx.com).
